answer_1.quote: Finally, Chart-to-Text generates natural language summaries from input charts
answer_1.outputs: natural language summaries from input charts

answer_2.quote: we utilize Relaxed Accuracy (RA) for ChartQA and BLEU for textgeneration tasks (Chart-to-Text and OpenCQA)

answer_3.quote: We further utilize ChatGPT for evaluating the same 150 samples, as LLMs have demonstrated their effectiveness as evaluators for text generation tasks

answer_4.quote: We randomly picked 150 sample charts from Chart2text Statista test split and asked 3 human annotators to rate four summaries for each chart based on informativeness out of 1 to 5
answer_4.guideline: We focus on following criteria in the chart summarization task:(1) Informativeness; (2) Factual Correctness; and(3) Semantic Levels that characterize the content of the summary
